items.note: Check sensors and connectors that the old harness may have shorted; those add to the bill.

items.job: Replace cylinder head gasket and head bolts
items.note: Cost rises if the head needs machining or the engine has overheated.

items.t: Sunroof glass panel can come loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and re-bond or replace sunroof glass panel
items.note: Free under Mercedes' sunroof recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mercedes dealer.

items.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the transmission
items.job: Replace radiator and flush transmission fluid
items.note: If coolant already damaged the transmission, a rebuild or replacement costs much more.

items.t: Timing chain stretch on the supercharged 4-cylinder
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides, tensioner and cam adjusters
items.note: Rebuilt cam adjusters cost less than new ones. Cost rises if the chain jumped and bent valves.

items.t: Oil wicking from camshaft solenoids into the wiring
items.job: Replace camshaft solenoids and add adapter harness
items.note: If oil has reached the engine computer or main harness, those parts cost much more.

items.t: Balance shaft or idler gear wear on the V6
items.job: Replace balance shaft and timing sprockets (engine removal)
items.note: Big engine-out job. Mercedes has paid part of the bill as goodwill for some owners, so ask the dealer.

items.job: Replace and program transmission conductor plate
items.note: Needs dealer-level programming. Some early valve bodies must be replaced too, which adds a lot.

items.job: Replace and program electronic steering lock (ESL)
items.note: Dealers may also replace the ignition switch and keys, which costs more. Independent shops often fit a cheaper emulator.

items.t: Timing chain and camshaft adjuster rattle on the turbo 4-cylinder
items.job: Replace camshaft adjusters, timing chain, guides and tensioner
items.note: Mercedes gave 10-year coverage on C250 cam adjusters; it has ended for most cars, but ask the dealer.

items.t: Starter circuit current limiter can overheat (recall)
items.job: Install fuse in starter current limiter circuit
items.note: Free under Mercedes' 2017 starter recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mercedes dealer.

items.t: Camshaft adjuster wear and oil in the engine wiring
items.note: If oil has wicked into the harness or engine computer, those parts add a lot. Worn adjusters inside the engine cost more.

items.t: Fuel pump can shut down while driving (recall)
items.note: Mercedes recalled these fuel pumps. Check your VIN or ask a Mercedes dealer.

items.job: Inspect and re-torque 12V and 48V ground connections
items.note: Free under Mercedes recall 23V-463. Check your VIN or ask a Mercedes dealer.

items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley (harmonic balancer) and drive belt

items.t: Piston knock and cracked pistons on the turbo 4-cylinder
items.job: Replace engine (used or remanufactured long block)
items.note: Worst case when a piston has cracked. Diagnosis alone is far less.

items.t: Driver's door lock switch can corrode and let the car roll away
items.note: Free under the Mercedes door lock recall. Check the VIN first.
